summary: This note is a clipped Wikipedia table listing the current leadership of the Joint Chiefs of Staff as of the page's snapshot. It names the Chairman, Vice Chairman, and the heads of the Army, Marine Corps, Navy, Air Force, and National Guard Bureau, along with each officer's service branch. The content is a roster only, with no narrative history or description of the Joint Chiefs' duties.
one_line: A snapshot roster of the Joint Chiefs of Staff leadership, listing each officer's position and military service.
key_facts: Gen. Joseph F. Dunford of the United States Marine Corps holds the position of Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff.
Gen. Paul J. Selva of the United States Air Force holds the position of Vice Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff.
Gen. Mark A. Milley of the United States Army holds the position of Chief of Staff of the Army.
Gen. Robert B. Neller of the United States Marine Corps holds the position of Commandant of the Marine Corps.
Adm. John M. Richardson of the United States Navy holds the position of Chief of Naval Operations.
Gen. David L. Goldfein of the United States Air Force holds the position of Chief of Staff of the Air Force.
Gen. Joseph L. Lengyel of the United States Air Force holds the position of Chief of the National Guard Bureau.
The note lists seven leadership positions in total, covering the Chairman, Vice Chairman, and five service chiefs or equivalents.
The Chairman and Vice Chairman listed are both officers from different services: Dunford from the Marine Corps and Selva from the Air Force.
The note contains no photographs or descriptions despite a 'Photograph' column header in the table.
